course.title: Power System I
course.department: Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering

content.value: Two balanced loads are connected to a 400V line in parallel. Load 1 draws 8KW at a p.f. 0.6 lagging while load 2 draws 6KVR at a p.f. 0.8 lagging. Determine (i) the total real and reactive power and power factor of the combined load, (ii) the line current and (iii) the KVAR rating of 3-φ capacitor that will raise the p.f. 0.9 lagging.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2016
